extracted_full.name: VINEETH SAGAR HL
projects: Zero-Day Attack Detection Using TGNN and Explainable AI in Kubernetes: Trained three models (TGNN, LSTM-AE, DeepLog) with temporal graph construction, integrated SHAP-based explainability with MITRE ATT&CK mapping, achieving 40% reduction in false positives and 2-second real-time anomaly detection.

Hybrid P2P-Cloud Anonymous Transfer Engine: Built stateless FastAPI backend with HS256 JWT auth and async Redis presence tracking; automated cloud cleanup via AWS Lambda burn-after-reading and S3 lifecycle rules; deployed non-root Docker containers under Kubernetes Secrets with least-privilege IAM policies, enforcing zero-trust principles.

NetCDF RAG Pipeline for Scientific Data: Constructed RAG pipeline over 5GB oceanographic data, parsed and embedded ~20k profile chunks into a vector database; developed async FastAPI service with LangChain generating fact-checked responses at 500 requests/minute and 95% factual accuracy; improved natural-language query accuracy from ~70% to ~90% and built interactive dashboard with multiple data widgets.
extracted_full.summary: Information Science and Engineering student at BMSIT&M with hands-on experience building production-grade intelligent systems, agentic AI, and RAG pipelines. Recognized hackathon prize winner and media leader, skilled in Python, Java, Docker, Kubernetes, and ML frameworks.
